_comment: WHERE posters hang (the poster pictures themselves are content: data/posters.json). Sizes in metres. billboard = 2:1 boards on roofs facing a main road; led = 16:9 screens on a pole at junction corners (they change poster every few seconds; 'junctions' [col,row] are always used first); wall = 2:3 posters on the first floor of shop buildings; busStop = 2:3 poster on the back board of every bus shelter; pillar = 2:3 posters on both sides of every MRT / flyover pillar; vehicles = 2:1 panels on the back of buses and on some rickshaws (rickshawShare / busShare = share of them that carry an advert). count = how many, minSpacing = least distance between two of the same kind. tap = how close (metres) Shoumik must be to open the poster's link. frameCell = size of the groups the frames are drawn in.
